response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS n_st FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.avg_bw, g.n_st, m.mean_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_bw > m.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_of_kept_averages, SUM(n_st) AS total_distinct_stations, AVG(avg_bw - mean_avg) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM k

assumptions.assumption: The mean of all phase averages is the unweighted mean of per-phase averages (each phase counts once), computed over phases whose average is non-null; phases with all-null bandwidth have a NULL average and are neither counted in the mean nor kept.
The inner join on observstation drops telescopes with no matching observatory; NULL lunarstage forms its own group via GROUP BY.
